component: Notification updater retry and time units

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted updater records successful updates, limits that history, and uses remaining cache time or a nonzero default interval after success. Failure schedules a bounded sequence of fallback intervals and increments a failure count. getRemainingCacheTime converts expiry seconds to Date.now milliseconds. Check the units at the arithmetic boundary and keep failed attempts out of successful-update history. Only this current source was inspected; no timing or rate-limit run occurred.
title: Keep retry delay, cache expiry and update history distinct
